dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: You're back, esteemed ones! How was the racing challenge?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We had a good time, and we feel great!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: A good time? That's good to hear! I would try it myself if I was stronger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe you should keep training, Tiantian! A strong recruiter is sure to bring more people in!

choices.text: The gunpowder gave Paimon a boost!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We set a record for the fastest time, and none of the other participants could catch up with us!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Ah, I'm starting to get excited myself! Maybe I could outdo you as the creator of this event?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehehe, that won't be easy. Maybe if you actually design a gunpowder-propelled backpack, maybe you might have a chance!

choices.text: We want to try it again. Goodbye!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Bye! I'll be here awaiting your feedback!
